description: This file implements a preprocessor for the Wesnoth project, handling macro definitions, file inclusion, macro substitution, and preprocessing directives. It defines classes for stream buffering, file processing, macro handling, and preprocessing logic.

classes.name: preprocessor
classes.description: Abstract base class for preprocessing, managing previous preprocessors and stream buffer context.

classes.name: preprocessor_streambuf
classes.description: Custom stream buffer for preprocessing output, handling buffer filling, macro expansion, and directive processing.

classes.name: preprocessor_file
classes.description: Handles preprocessing of files, including directory traversal and file inclusion.

classes.name: preprocessor_data
classes.description: Handles tokenization and macro processing within the preprocessing stream.

methods.name: underflow
methods.description: Refills the buffer with processed data, handling macro expansion and directives.

methods.name: preprocessor
methods.description: Constructor initializing the preprocessor with a stream buffer context.

methods.name: preprocessor_file
methods.description: Constructor for file-based preprocessing, handling directory traversal.

methods.name: get_chunk
methods.description: Processes the next chunk of data, handling macro expansion, directives, and file inclusion.
